prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop landing-page direction comp for TomorrowWorks
Primary request: Render the first viewport and start of the next section of a public Malaysian career guidance website, edge to edge, with crisp readable text and no browser frame. The visitor wants a credible next career direction.
Real content: brand “TomorrowWorks”; navigation “Explore careers”, “Job market”, “How it works”, “For organisations”; utility “BM / 中文”; headline “Your experience can take you further.”; supporting copy “Discover career directions that fit your skills, see what is changing in Malaysia, and build a realistic learning plan.”; working input “What do you do now?” containing “Accounting assistant”; primary action “Find my direction”; trust line “Malaysian job-market evidence · Recognised skill data · No CV required”; direction states “Bookkeeper”, “Accountant”, “Data analyst”; next section begins “From where you are to what comes next”.
Concept: First Light. A theatre cyclorama moving from black night through cobalt and rose to white day carries the entire first viewport. Career directions appear as named light cues along the horizon. The skill input and primary action live inside the first-light band. One transition is dominant; the next section is a quieter continuation of the same material.
References: the attached board and hero supply the palette, atmospheric light, typography character, material commitment, and finish level only. Adapt them into a working TomorrowWorks public website; do not copy their layout, navigation, copy, silhouettes, or production content.
Constraints: accessible readable text, unmistakable form controls, no sidebar, no dashboard, no generic split hero, no cards row, no invented statistics, no fake testimonials, no AI robot imagery, no watermark.
